title: Technical reference
---

::: {.callout-note title="Incremental reference"}
The first source-linked component inventory is available in
[Localization and component reference](../vba/localization-and-components.qmd).
Further inventories should be generated from source metadata where reliable.
:::

The reference section is for precise lookup information rather than tutorials
or architectural explanation.

## Planned inventories

- complete public-procedure inventory for standard modules and classes;
- form controls and invoking commands;
- global variables and constants;
- registry keys and configuration values;
- database tables, fields, and supported types;
- SQL-building helpers and escaping rules;
- ribbon commands and keyboard-visible labels;
- supported Excel, Windows, Python, database, and NADABAS versions.

Names and casing must match the exported source exactly. Automated inventories
should be preferred when they can be tested and reviewed.
